jobs.title: Assistant Head of Department / Senior Team Leader

projects.name: 📱 Blom Bank Mobile Application
projects.desc: Comprehensive mobile banking platform covering 70%+ of essential bank services with 120,000+ active users and 12,000+ daily logins. Includes live video and text chat with call-centre agents — especially vital during the COVID-19 pandemic.

projects.name: 🇯🇴 Blom Bank Jordan Mobile Application
projects.desc: Dedicated app for Jordanian customers covering 65%+ of banking needs, tailored to local regulations and connected to trusted Jordanian third-party providers for secure payments and SMS.

projects.name: 🕌 Blom Islamic Bank Portal (eBDB)
projects.desc: Online portal giving customers convenient access to Blom Islamic Bank's full suite of Sharia-compliant financial products, adhering strictly to Islamic ethical and financial principles.

projects.name: 🔄 Blom Bank Centralised Workflow
projects.desc: Redesigned branch processes into a centralised digital workflow optimising loan, check, card, and core banking activities across 80+ branches and head offices, with a multi-level escalation system.

projects.name: ✅ Clearing System
projects.desc: Streamlined check management across all branches via integrated scanning, routing directly to and from the BDL clearing house — handling 10,000+ checks daily in multiple currencies.

projects.name: 💹 Misys Treasury (Sophis Value)
projects.desc: Full IT support for all treasury operations — front, middle, and back office. Deep expertise in FX (spot, forward, swaps), fixed income, and money market modules.

projects.name: 📊 Asset Fund Management
projects.desc: Supported an application managing open-end, closed-end, listed and non-listed funds and structured products, including all financial reports and client confirmation letters.

projects.name: 🏦 Trade Finance
projects.desc: Implemented digital credit workflow from branch initiation to departmental approval. Full support for letters of credit and guarantees from request through issuance to settlement.

projects.name: 📡 FX Blotter — Reuters Interface
projects.desc: Real-time P&L, position, and currency exposure from Reuters prices. Money-market cash flow via parametric maturity ladder with real-time updates after every interbank operation.

projects.name: 📈 Profitability & Customer Global Exposure
projects.desc: Analytical reporting suite showing bank profitability by customer and branch, with a global view of all client positions.

projects.name: 💳 Payroll & Online Trading
projects.desc: Monitored payroll accounting entries, generated gateway files for Core Banking, and supported the bank's online trading application.

projects.name: 🏠 Bank of Beirut — Real Estate Portal
projects.desc: Developed the bank's digital real estate platform for customer-facing property services.

projects.name: 🌐 Bank of Beirut — Online Banking
projects.desc: Contributed to building the bank's online banking platform, enabling customers to manage accounts digitally.

projects.name: 📋 LACPA — Internal Administration System
projects.desc: Built an internal administration management application for the Lebanese Association of Certified Public Accountants.

projects.name: 🔬 Eurofins — Internal Application
projects.desc: Developed an internal operations management application for a European medical laboratory company.
